name: code-review-kit
description: Structured code review, conventional commits and PR descriptions performed by the agent on local git diffs. No API keys, no external services — the agent reads your diff, applies a severity-ordered checklist and reports actionable findings.

description_i18n.en: Structured code review, conventional commits and PR descriptions performed by the agent on local git diffs. No API keys, no external services — the agent reads your diff, applies a severity-ordered checklist and reports actionable findings.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 基于本地 git diff 的结构化代码评审、约定式提交信息与 PR 描述生成，全部由 agent 完成。无需 API 密钥、无需外部服务——agent 阅读你的改动，按严重程度逐项检查清单，并给出可执行的评审结论。
